text:
I got a call from control at 12:00 on Feb 3, 2026, about a CO2 leak at Larchwood Liquids
Pipeline Inc.'s Montreal East station. SCADA indicated a release. The leak is through the pipe
body or a weld, not sure which. Metering shows 20.0 m³ released. Control said everything is
still inside the station fence. They didn't give me any other details. I haven't spoken to ops
on site yet. The product released is CO2. I'll try to get more info from the field team and
follow up.
S. Patel, On-Call CRO
